description: This file defines an interface 'IdentifierValidator' for patient identifier validation within the OpenMRS project. It declares methods for validating identifiers, generating valid identifiers, and retrieving validator metadata.

classes.name: IdentifierValidator
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for validating and generating patient identifiers.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the validator, e.g., 'Luhn Algorithm'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given identifier is valid according to the validator, throws exception if unallowed characters are present.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier
methods.description: Transforms an undecorated identifier into a validated identifier with check digit or other validation.

methods.name: getAllowedCharacters
methods.description: Returns the set of characters permitted in the identifier.
